policy_name: Sierra Mutual Underwriting Model Deployment Policy
owner: Model Risk Officer (second line of defense)
rationale: Original thresholds were set before model results were seen. The FPR-ratio threshold was added as a policy standard before rerunning models under the new control, within the course-recommended 0.70 to 0.80 range. In this repository a model author may TIGHTEN a threshold or ADD a control in the same pull request; the CI integrity check reports every such change for owner review and refuses any change that loosens a threshold or shortens a protection list.
